opening.argument: The presentation shows CoinPay as a payment and shopping service for merchants and customers. It describes a way to accept customer payments, with merchants able to receive funds in digital currency, fiat currency, or a mix of both; the account screen also shows allocation and loyalty settings. The promotional call to action and website invite viewers to use the service, but the supplied material shows no deceptive guarantee, impersonation, fabricated result, or concrete fraud mechanism. Although the title asks whether Bitclub Network is a scam, the observable advertisement focuses on CoinPay functionality rather than endorsing a specific fraudulent investment.
